# Leamington Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Leamington. Ductless AC installation covers planning and installing mini-split indoor and outdoor equipment, refrigerant line sets, electrical connections, and room-specific cooling zones.

Email: contact@leamingtonheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://leamingtonheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Leamington, Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Amherstburg, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
